evidence: Runtime fact list (skill quality-checks.md s4) vs what test.sh and the judges consume; every item is stated publicly. (1) Path: instruction.md:15 'Put the application in /app'; integration.md:5. (2) Start command: instruction.md:15 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:21-23 says it is started from a different working directory under a locked-down account; hireops_rules.md:206-210 adds the writable-copy case, matching test.sh's APP_COPY fallback (APP_ENTRY=$APP_COPY/server.js when /app is not writable; setpriv --reuid=65534). (3) Port: instruction.md:15 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh PORT="3000"; every prompt opens http://localhost:3000; app_context.md:4 agrees. (4) Storage: instruction.md:15 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; test.sh DB_PATH="$APP_DB". (5) Env: test.sh env -i injects PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH; hireops_rules.md:209-210 names exactly these five; integration.md:3-4,18-19 name NODE_PATH. (6) Health: instruction.md:15 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh probe_ready tries /api/health then /. (7) Seed: instruction.md:15-17 '/assets/seed_data.json' and 'Load ... once, start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts'; hireops_rules.md:212-217 explains read markers, candidate labels and page size 30. (8) Accounts: instruction.md:19 lists all 10 emails with roles and password Hireops!2026, matching app_context.md:8-19 one-to-one. (9) Fixed clock: none needed. No criterion depends on absolute time (grep for clock/today/date/ago across tests, brief and notes found nothing); ordering criteria use actions made during the review. (10) Network: public profile. instruction.md:15 allows CDN on the browser side and forbids only an outside data service, consistent with integration.md:12-14; no no-network constraint is required (public workbook col D; SKILL delivery profile). Graded-vs-asked sweep over every criterion (2 gate, 41 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual): each demand traces to the brief or notes. Examples: 401/403/404 statuses (hro_anonymous, hro_refusal_status) <- rules.md:22-24; 409 naming who (hro_stale_refused) <- instruction.md:3, rules.md:78-82; whole-number 1..50 places and hiring-manager-account pick (hro_job_open) <- rules.md:28-30; case-insensitive duplicate email, error at the field, typed values kept (hro_add_email_rules) <- rules.md:32-36; arrive at bottom, board-order bulk landing, all-or-none, Interview counted for the whole set <- rules.md:57-58,92-95; reopen only to the rejected-from stage, reason cleared, undo restores the reason <- rules.md:49-51,99-104; undo blocked by a move/re-order/reject by anyone, once only, superseded by a later move <- rules.md:99-104; focus kept on the refused card (hro_refused_put_back) <- rules.md:86-88; Activity lines incl. re-orders and undos, newest first, per-job filter, no refused lines <- rules.md:114-118; 15 s live updates preserving typing, focus, open card and scroll <- instruction.md:5, rules.md:122-128; plain text, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty focused box, failed send kept (hro_msg_compose, hro_pol_failed_send) <- rules.md:144-146; latest 30, earlier 30 with remaining count, anchor kept <- rules.md:150-153; unread and seen semantics incl. Observer never counting <- rules.md:157-172; drafts per conversation across reload and sign-out, hidden from another user, note draft kept 'for me on that browser' (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume) <- instruction.md:7, rules.md:110,176-181; candidate wording and leak list (hro_candidate_view/private) <- rules.md:185-202 plus seed jobs/teams. Seeded facts the judges rely on were re-derived from seed_data.json and are correct: Platform Engineer Applied order Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz; Noor's note on APP-101; APP-101 has 120 messages; Lena (APP-301) has 3 messages, read_count 2, last by Farah, so 1 unread; Noor PE Infrastructure/Interview, Noor PD Design/Applied, Tomas DA Finance Systems/Screen. Golden corroboration (source only): bootstrap.js:20,43 health answered before DB work and PORT||3000; db.js:9-10 DB_PATH||<app>/app.db with __dirname-relative seed; index.js:90 server-issued HttpOnly session cookie. Raw-evidence-index hashes verified; the scripted golden run is not a configured judge run, and this source row does not need one. Lessons file checked for this row: lessons 1/12 (no hidden or golden-only requirements) applied to every criterion above, none found; lesson 13 (no public address in judge prompts) holds, every prompt uses localhost:3000 only. Non-blocking observations: (a) The constraints gate and the in-dimension gates of all three scored prompts require 'Reload the page: the visitor is still signed in'. No single sentence says that, but it is conveyed by contrast: rules.md:59 'after a reload, a fresh sign-in or a restart' and rules.md:177-179 / instruction.md:7 treat a reload separately from a session ending, and rules.md:11-12 'the session the server gave out'. The conforming-alternative probe (memory-only token, re-sign-in after reload) contradicts those sentences, so I judge it asked for; it is the closest thing to an implicit demand and sits on a hard gate. (b) instruction.md:17 says /assets is unavailable at runtime while test.sh makes /assets readable; conservative and harmless, since an app that copies the seed passes either way. (c) test.sh passes DB_PATH equal to the default /app/app.db, so an app that ignores DB_PATH is not caught; that is verification strength for other rows, not a missing statement here. Broken-app probe: an app listening only on a hard-coded non-3000 port, or reading its seed/pages from cwd, scores 0, but both are excluded by the stated contract (instruction.md:15, integration.md:21-23, rules.md:206-210), so that 0 is attributable to the submission, not the harness.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening only, not required for this Pass: add one plain sentence such as 'Reloading the page keeps me signed in' so the gate's reload leg is stated directly rather than by contrast.
